verdict.rationale: Azure publishes an official Pricing Calculator page and public pricing pages under azure.microsoft.com/pricing, covering pay-as-you-go purchase options and free services. The evidence is only page titles, though, and no per-service rate page (e.g., VM or database pricing) is shown. One community complaint calls the pricing 'opaque', but that is sentiment, not a concrete counter-example that prices are unpublished. missing for 10: evidence of public per-service pricing pages with actual rates, documented calculator capabilities for estimating a multi-service stack, independent or hands-on corroboration of using the calculator before signup.

support.subject: As a founder, prices are published — public per-service pricing pages and an official calculator I can estimate a stack with before signing anything
